title: Sabbath Bible Quiz
subtitle: 10 questions from the King James Version
author: doc-studio test

summary.topic: A 10-question quiz on what the Bible says about the Sabbath, from Genesis to Hebrews.
key_points: Every answer is in a KJV verse fetched from BibleGateway
The reference for each answer is in the answer key
In Excel, choose A-D in the yellow column to mark yourself
summary.takeaway: Read the verses in the answer key after the quiz.

blocks.q: On which day did God end His work of creation and rest?
What two things did God do to the seventh day in Genesis 2:3?
What is the first word of the fourth commandment?
How many days does the commandment say we should labour?
Which reason does Exodus 20:11 give for the Sabbath?
choices: The Lord made heaven and earth in six days and rested

blocks.q: According to Jesus, the sabbath was made for...
Jesus said the Son of man is Lord also of...
What does Isaiah 58:13 say we should call the sabbath?
Hebrews 4:9 says there remaineth a rest to...
Whom does Jesus invite to come to Him for rest in Matthew 11:28?
choices: All that labour and are heavy laden

references.text: Genesis 2:1-3; Exodus 20:8-11; Mark 2:27-28; Isaiah 58:13-14; Hebrews 4:9-10; Matthew 11:28, King James Version (BibleGateway)
